preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A1 <= 10**9 for A1, D, L, R in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first element of the arithmetic progression A1 is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= D <= 10**9 for A1, D, L, R in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the common difference D is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L <= R <= 10**18 for A1, D, L, R in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, L and R are between 1 and 10^18 inclusive, and L is less than or equal to R.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in output)
postconditions.description: Each output result is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(result == sum(F(A1 + (i-1)*D) for i in range(L, R+1)) for result, (A1, D, L, R) in zip(output, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each output result is the sum of F(Ai) for L ≤ i ≤ R, where Ai is the i-th term of the arithmetic progression.
